description: LongMemEval-style fixture evaluating session-distance recall for Ohara FTS5 retrieval.

facts.title: JWT signing algorithm is RS256
facts.body: All JWT tokens are signed using RS256 with a 2048-bit RSA key pair. The public key is available at /.well-known/jwks.json.

facts.title: Session TTL is 24 hours
facts.body: User sessions expire after 24 hours of inactivity. The TTL is configured via SESSION_TTL_HOURS env var, defaulting to 24.

facts.title: Login rate limit is 5 per minute
facts.body: The login endpoint applies a rate limit of 5 attempts per minute per IP address. Exceeding this triggers a 429 response with a Retry-After header.

facts.title: OAuth providers: Google and GitHub
facts.body: The application supports OAuth 2.0 login via Google and GitHub. Provider configuration is stored in the oauth_providers table.

facts.title: Refresh token rotation enabled
facts.body: When a refresh token is used, the old token is invalidated and a new refresh token is issued. Reuse detection triggers revocation of all tokens for that user.

facts.title: Database migrations use golang-migrate
facts.body: All schema migrations are managed by golang-migrate v4. Migration files are numbered sequentially and stored in internal/store/migrations/.

facts.title: SQLite WAL mode is always enabled
facts.body: Every SQLite connection opens with PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL. This is enforced in the connection setup in store.go.

facts.title: FTS5 index rebuilt on migration 005
facts.body: Migration 005 drops and recreates the FTS5 content table to include the new body column. The rebuild is idempotent.

facts.title: Connection pool size is 25
facts.body: The sql.DB connection pool is configured with SetMaxOpenConns(25) and SetMaxIdleConns(5). These values were tuned for the 4-core production instances.

facts.title: API versioned via /v1/ prefix
facts.body: All REST endpoints are prefixed with /v1/. Breaking changes will introduce /v2/ while keeping /v1/ deprecated for 6 months.

facts.title: Error responses use RFC 7807 Problem Details
facts.body: All API errors are returned as application/problem+json with type, title, status, and detail fields. Validation errors include an errors array.

facts.title: Cursor-based pagination for list endpoints
facts.body: List endpoints use cursor-based pagination with a page_token query parameter. The cursor is an opaque base64-encoded string containing the last item ID.

facts.title: Cache-Control headers set on GET responses
facts.body: GET responses include Cache-Control: private, max-age=60 for authenticated endpoints. Public endpoints use max-age=300. ETag headers are also included.

facts.title: Prometheus metrics on port 9090
facts.body: The application exposes Prometheus metrics on a separate HTTP server listening on port 9090. The /metrics endpoint is not exposed on the main API port.

facts.title: Health check endpoint at /healthz
facts.body: The /healthz endpoint returns 200 if the database and all upstream dependencies are reachable. It returns 503 otherwise with a JSON body listing failing checks.

facts.title: Structured logging with slog levels
facts.body: All logging uses Go's slog package with JSON output. Log level is controlled by LOG_LEVEL env var (debug, info, warn, error). Request IDs are injected via middleware.

facts.title: Graceful shutdown with 30s timeout
facts.body: On SIGTERM or SIGINT, the server stops accepting new requests, drains in-flight requests with a 30-second timeout, then closes database connections.

facts.title: CORS allows only app.example.com
facts.body: The CORS middleware restricts Access-Control-Allow-Origin to https://app.example.com. Preflight OPTIONS requests are cached for 1 hour.

facts.title: Passwords hashed with bcrypt cost 12
facts.body: User passwords are hashed using bcrypt with cost factor 12. Legacy accounts with cost 10 are re-hashed on next successful login.

facts.title: MFA uses TOTP with 6-digit codes
facts.body: Multi-factor authentication uses TOTP (RFC 6238) with 6-digit codes and a 30-second time step. Backup codes are 8-character alphanumeric strings, one-time use.
